concepts.def: EM wave; no mass or charge

walkthroughs.body_html:
Alpha: mass -4, atomic -2.

Beta-minus: mass unchanged, atomic +1.

Gamma: no change to mass or atomic number.

After 1 half-life: half the activity.

After 2 half-lives: a quarter. After 3: an eighth.

Activity halves every half-life.

Predict by counting how many half-lives have passed.
